subject: general
question: 'Garibi hatao' was the slogan of which political leader?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi.**__

__
 
• '**Garibi hatao' was the slogan of Indira Gandhi__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Garibi Hatao **meaning Remove Poverty was the theme and slogan of Indira Gandhi's 1971 election campaign.
 
• It was a part of the five-year plan.
 
• The slogan and the proposed anti-poverty programs were designed to reach out directly to the poor and marginalized bypassing the dominant rural castes.
